annotation.title_clean: PL n. 2008/2024 - Dispõe sobre a prevenção e repressão às infrações contra a ordem econômica através do uso de Inteligência Artificial (IA)
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 2008/2024 - On the prevention and repression of infringements against the economic order through the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Vinicius Carvalho, Republicanos/SP)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 2008/2024 amends Law 12.529/2011 (competition law) by adding to Article 36 an infringement against the economic order: using artificial intelligence to carry out unfair competition practices such as price manipulation, cartels and industrial espionage. It has no embodied or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Art. 36 of Law 12.529/2011 to add use of AI for unfair competition practices as an infringement of the economic order
Justification cites price manipulation, cartels and industrial espionage as examples
Law would take effect on the date of publication
Penalties remain those in Arts. 37-45 of Law 12.529/2011
